items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 17:1
items.html: Its Rosh, namely the discernment from below upward, is the Rishayhu of AVI, called the mutual looking of the eyes of AVI, which emerged upon phase four of clothing and phase three of coarseness, which were included one within the other, bringing out the level of Keter. And the body of this level of Keter, which is its discernment from above downward, expanded in the king Da'at. And it is the discernment of Yechida of ZON. (p. 518, Item 41. And in the Inner Light there, Sub Header, “Da'at”)
